**Implementation note:** Stacks forecasters' outputs; no portfolio optimizer.

## Description

Combines several distinct alpha forecasts or strategy returns using validation-based weights, risk controls or stacking models.

## Where it may fit

When independent signals have complementary strengths and their correlation structure is stable enough to estimate.

## Vehicles

Multi-strategy funds, quant equity, systematic macro and strategy sleeves.

## Required data

Out-of-sample strategy returns/signals, covariance, forecasts, transaction costs, risk limits and chronological training splits.

## Caveats

Ensemble weights can overfit backtests; use nested walk-forward validation, shrinkage and conservative limits on model complexity.
